record.question: In FIFA World Cup, ________ is the top goalscorer with a record of 16 goals across four World Cups.
record.explanation: Answer B: Miroslav Klose. Miroslav Klose scored 16 goals across four FIFA World Cups, a tournament record at the time of the paper. Reference: https://www.fifa.com/tournaments/mens/worldcup/2014brazil/news/klose-breaks-world-cup-goals-record-2404031. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
